given_when_then.given: A financial transaction record has been generated
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to finalize the settlement status
given_when_then.then: The system verifies that verifiable delivery evidence is linked to the record

given_when_then.given: The linked delivery proof is missing
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to finalize the settlement status
given_when_then.then: The system flags the record as incomplete and prevents final settlement

given_when_then.given: The system is archiving a financial transaction record
given_when_then.when: The record includes item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts
given_when_then.then: The system includes these fields in the archived record

given_when_then.given: The system is archiving a financial transaction record
given_when_then.when: The record is associated with a specific store partner
given_when_then.then: The system archives the relevant store partner agreement contractual details alongside the record

given_when_then.given: A non-standard process deviation occurs during transaction processing
given_when_then.then: The system records the nature of the issue and the current resolution status

success_criteria: The financial transaction record must be linked to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
The record must contain item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
If delivery proof is missing, the system must flag the record as incomplete.
The system must prevent final settlement if the delivery proof is not provided.
Contractual details and payout schedules must be archived alongside the financial transaction record.
Any deviation from the standard process must be recorded with the nature of the issue and the current resolution status.
